what: Compare a lifter with similar competition performances — compare_lifter
title: Compare a lifter with similar competition performances — compare_lifter
text: Filters historical competition results sex, equipment bodyweight window, optionally adding age window. calculates empirical percentiles squat, bench press, deadlift total. percentile percentage matching performances less equal entered lift.

title: Compare a lifter with similar competition performances — compare_lifter
code: compare_lifter(   data = NULL,   sex,   equipment,   bodyweight,   squat,   bench,   deadlift,   age = NULL,   bodyweight_tolerance = 5,   age_tolerance = 5,   min_n = 30 )

title: Compare a lifter with similar competition performances — compare_lifter
text: data data frame fields powerlifting, NULL use packaged data. sex One "F" "M". equipment One "Raw", "Wraps", "Single-ply", "Multi-ply". bodyweight Bodyweight kilograms. squat, bench, deadlift Best successful lifts kilograms. age Optional age years. NULL, age used matching. bodyweight_tolerance Maximum difference bodyweight, kilograms, performance considered similar. age_tolerance Maximum age difference years age supplied. min_n Minimum desired peer-group size. result still returned threshold, weak_sample set TRUE.

title: Compare a lifter with similar competition performances — compare_lifter
text: list containing summary, four-row data frame lift values percentiles; peers, filtered records; n, peer count; weak_sample; weakest_lift; applied filters.

title: Compare a lifter with similar competition performances — compare_lifter
code: result <- compare_lifter(   powerlifting, sex = "F", equipment = "Raw", bodyweight = 63,   squat = 110, bench = 60, deadlift = 140 ) result$summary #>                 lift entered_kg peer_median_kg percentile #> squat_kg       Squat        110          102.5       64.7 #> bench_kg       Bench         60           57.5       59.2 #> deadlift_kg Deadlift        140          127.5       70.1 #> total_kg       Total        310          290.0       65.0 result$weakest_lift #> [1] "Bench"

title: Historical OpenPowerlifting competition performances — powerlifting
text: prepared extract complete three-lift competition performances OpenPowerlifting database. Records missing positive squat, bench press, deadlift, total, bodyweight removed. data historical snapshot person can occur across competitions.

title: Historical OpenPowerlifting competition performances — powerlifting
text: data frame one row per competition performance 11 fields: sex Competition sex category: F M. equipment Equipment category. age Age years; may missing. bodyweight_kg Recorded bodyweight kilograms. weight_class_kg Meet-reported weight class. squat_kg Best successful squat kilograms. bench_kg Best successful bench press kilograms. deadlift_kg Best successful deadlift kilograms. total_kg Official three-lift total kilograms. place Meet-reported placing, including non-numeric statuses. wilks Meet-reported Wilks score; may missing.

title: Historical OpenPowerlifting competition performances — powerlifting
text: OpenPowerlifting, historical database extract distributed https://www.kaggle.com/open-powerlifting/powerlifting-database. Current project documentation https://openpowerlifting.gitlab.io/opl-csv/bulk-csv-docs.html.
